algorithm: deterministic CPU-only ranker; no embeddings, no case IDs, no benchmark-specific strings
claim_boundary: Auxiliary algorithm evidence only until formal methodology and strong-baseline gates permit otherwise.
selection_rule: Keep v2 only if adversarial development and validation improve MRR over v1 without reducing Recall@5 on those sets; abstention remains a separate research track and is not claimed solved.
target_failure: lexical-copy and keyword-stuffing distractors that exploit query overlap while preserving state-transition retrieval
withheld_rule: After source/config freeze, generate a new operator-designed procedural withheld set and evaluate exactly once without tuning to it.
